prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: Full normal-reference projection improved patient CV, while finer foreground features and normal-axis adversarial training did not establish a successor. Test a different operation: use patient-balanced normal residual energy to guide learned local attention. This is statistical feature deviation, not a lesion label or localization claim.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Original fit-only standardization and normal-patient PCA32 for each stream. Apply full projection first. Estimate regional first and centered second moments using equal normal-patient weights, equal images within patient and equal tokens for pooled scope; position scope keeps9location references. Variance floor.05^2. Freeze all16arm/phase geometries and16patient plans before fitting.
prior_hypothesis.architecture: Keep identical attentionMLP trainable parameters,initialization,full task,weights,hparams and3seeds. Calculate per-token RMS of standardized projected regional residuals; bias=strength*tanh(log(RMS+1e-6)),centered over9tokens. Add the same scalar prior to both learned attention heads. Pooled/position references and strength.5/2 produce4arms48actualheads; score each alone and fixed.75new/.25M5,8candidates0fusionfits.
